# Clarity Ventures

> Clarity Ventures delivers integrated B2B eCommerce platforms with native ERP/CRM connectivity, AI-powered personalization, and multi-vendor marketplace capabilities for manufacturers, wholesalers, and enterprises.

Clarity Ventures specializes in enterprise-grade B2B eCommerce solutions that seamlessly integrate with leading ERP systems (Sage, Epicor, Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics) and CRM platforms. The company serves manufacturers, wholesalers, and multi-vendor marketplace operators seeking scalable, omnichannel commerce infrastructure with advanced features like buying groups, membership models, and subscription management.
